verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a public REST API that gives programmatic control over the entire platform and underpins its CLI and SDK. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.vast.ai/api/openapi.json, and scoped API keys are documented for automation and CI/CD. The open-source vast-cli GitHub repo shows programmatic SDK usage built on the same API, and an agent skill lets AI assistants drive the platform. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of using the REST API directly (community evidence does not address the API).
